formats.name: Feed post, square
formats.crop_notes: Profile grid shows posts as 3:4 tiles (since early 2025): 4:5 posts lose a little on the left/right, 1:1 posts are shown center-cropped, 3:4 posts show in full. Preview can be adjusted per post ('Adjust preview').
formats.notes: Instagram keeps photos 320-1080px wide at original resolution when aspect ratio is between 1.91:1 and 3:4 (1080 wide x 566-1440 high); unsupported ratios are cropped, wider images downscaled to 1080, narrower upscaled to 320. Hashtag cap is now 5 per post (Help Center; rolled out from Dec 2025) - the Graph API reference still says 30, treat 5 as binding. The 125-char 'more' fold is observed, not published (secondary). File size for app uploads is not published; the publishing API caps images at 8MB JPEG.
